remarks: Bright & sunny move-in-ready studio in the heart of downtown Greenwich, just one block from Greenwich Avenue. Ideal as a pied-a-terre, full-time residence, or investment property. Recently updated kitchen features high-end appliances, sleek cabinetry, and stylish finishes. Elegant wood floors, recessed lighting, plantation shutters, and multiple closets add charm and functionality throughout. Fairfield House offers beautifully maintained green spaces and a peaceful setting while being moments from top restaurants, shopping, and Metro-North. Ample outdoor parking plus underground parking available for $60/month. A rare opportunity to enjoy convenient in-town Greenwich living.
